injury_note: Jeanty injured his right ankle during Raiders practice on August 23 after diving for a pass and landing awkwardly. Although he initially couldn't put much weight on the leg, the injury was later identified as a low-ankle sprain and was not considered long-term.

Brown is expected to miss roughly 4–6 weeks. Because he is on IR, he must miss at least four games, making Week 6 the earliest he can return. High-ankle sprains can affect cutting, acceleration, and explosiveness even after a player returns, so his performance and workload will be worth monitoring initially.

Bowers suffered a knee injury during training camp that was diagnosed as a meniscus issue. He underwent a meniscus trim on September 8 and is expected to miss approximately 1–2 games. He did not participate in the Raiders' Wednesday practice ahead of Week 1.

Nabers has made major progress and was a full participant in Giants practice on September 9, including taking contact in pads. Head coach John Harbaugh said he thinks Nabers is ready, although the team is still evaluating him before Week 1 against Dallas. His full participation is a strong indication he's close to game clearance, but returning from ACL reconstruction carries elevated early-season reinjury/compensation risk and his workload could initially be managed.

Love returned to practice as a limited participant on September 9. Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur has expressed optimism about him playing Week 1 against the Chargers and said there was “no limit” from the coaching side. Even if active, the high-ankle sprain and missed practice time could lead Arizona to ease him in alongside Tyler Allgeier.

Warren has recovered well and was not listed on the Colts' Week 1 injury report on September 9. Indianapolis reported that every player on the 53-man roster practiced, and Warren wasn't among the limited players. He appears ready for a normal Week 1 role against Baltimore.

Hill suffered a devastating left knee dislocation on September 29, 2025, with multiple ligament tears including the ACL. He underwent two surgeries and has spent nearly a year rebuilding strength and explosiveness in the leg.
injury_name: Left knee dislocation with multi-ligament tears (including ACL)
